rows.label: Chapter 1: Forsaken City — Cassette Tape
rows.note: Right at the Chasm checkpoint — move the block aside, go up, then behind the wall-stuck zipper. Unlocks 1B, and is the earliest point for the Gateway achievement.

rows.label: Chapter 2: Old Site — Cassette Tape
rows.note: In Start, after the mirror shatters and the dream blocks activate. Dash down through the dream block in the floor at the centre of the central room.

rows.label: Chapter 3: Celestial Resort — Cassette Tape
rows.note: In Elevator Shaft, left of the key in the seventh room, through a hole in the wall with light coming through it.

rows.label: Chapter 4: Golden Ridge — Cassette Tape
rows.note: In Start, top-left of the tenth room. Jump the clouds, go back left and dash up; continue left past the seeded-strawberry room.

rows.label: Chapter 5: Mirror Temple — Cassette Tape
rows.note: In Depths, past the third Temple Gate. A red bubble leads to three dash-switch rooms; the cassette room is through cracked wall at the bottom right of the third.

rows.label: Chapter 6: Reflection — Cassette Tape
rows.note: At the beginning of Hollows, same section as the Crystal Heart. Crash the Kevin Block into the far-left wall to open the hidden entrance.

rows.label: Chapter 7: The Summit — Cassette Tape
rows.note: In 1500 M, fifth room — an opening in the ceiling leads to the cassette room.

rows.label: Chapter 8: Core — Cassette Tape
rows.note: At the end of the level, alongside the Crystal Heart. Collecting both is necessary to complete Core.
